content.text:
Mira settled best swaddled on her back as a young baby, and you dropped the swaddle at 5 months.

That's a pretty typical point to transition out — once babies start showing signs of rolling, the swaddle becomes a safety concern rather than a help, so most families phase it out right around then.

If you're asking because something's come up with sleep now at 18 months, happy to dig into what might help — just let me know what you're seeing.
